# Peer-reviewed papers

Short papers published in conference proceedings are marked with **[short paper]**.

```{r articles-pub,echo=F,results="asis",cache=FALSE}
by_year <- function(bib, y){
    if(is.null(bib)) return(NULL)
    suppressMessages(bib[list(year=as.character(y))])
}
years <- sort(unique(as.numeric(c(articles$year, inproceedings$year))), decreasing = TRUE)
for(y in years){
    articles_y <- by_year(articles, y)
    inproceedings_y <- by_year(inproceedings, y)
    if(length(articles_y)!=0 || length(inproceedings_y)!=0){
        cat(paste0("## ",as.character(y),"\n" ))
        if(length(articles_y)!=0){
            output(articles_y)
        }
        if(length(inproceedings_y)!=0){
            output(inproceedings_y, flag = "short paper")
        }
    }
}
```

```{r,echo=F,results="asis",cache=F}
if(!is.null(unpublished) && length(unpublished) != 0){
    cat("# Unpublished manuscripts\n\n")
    output(unpublished)
}
```
